readout: Growth-rate fitness relative to wild type in a host with a functioning Lon protease; higher is fitter
assay_method: Bulk competition of an inverse-PCR site-saturation library of Escherichia coli dihydrofolate reductase in BL21(DE3). Variant frequencies were followed through early-log growth by Illumina NextSeq at several timepoints and converted to growth-rate fitness with Enrich2; three biological replicates were averaged. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: Of the deposit's 3132 rows, 615 substitutions carry no score and are dropped, as are all 153 nonsense rows, a premature stop not being writable as a substitution (139 of those had no score either). The wild-type row is the deposit's own _wt entry and reads exactly 0, the score being a fitness relative to wild type rather than a separate measurement.
